datePolicy: Original register explicitly dates every cited source/listing to 2026-11-05. No external source was freshly fetched during localization. USPS tariff effective 2026-10-04 is not a guaranteed January 2027 tariff; refresh at launch and after the 2027-01-17 peak boundary.
uncertainties: Planning help, not tax or legal advice. Individual registration, income tax and business duties remain unresolved; marketplace-only treatment does not cover all sales channels.

Competitor prices are recommendation-tile observations, never confirmed selected-size or checkout offers. Final two starting prices may be smaller variants and are excluded from numeric benchmarking. Stock, sale validity, shipping, shop handles and net-fill distinctions remain as qualified in the guide.
Labour, losses, overhead, volume, buyer tax and landed reserve are assumptions. Startup and fee-tax zeros are UNSET, not free costs. Paid Etsy Ads zero assumes disabled. Demand is not forecast.

Retail postage includes peak adjustment; measure actual parcel and obtain current ZIP-specific quote. Commercial labels, unusual parcels and bundles require separate verification. Hypothetical carton dimensions are not the selected box dimensions.

Wick/recipe/fill and supplier standards claims are not safety certification. Burn testing, insurance and actual costs are still required. Shipper unit price is observed but checkout pack/MOQ remains unverified.
Original workbook recalculation is reported by the source register, not repeated by localization; formulas and cached values were inspected read-only.
editingContract: Readable EN/ZH corresponding lines and table cells preserve numeric/date/currency/URL parity; local draft only, no stars or review markup.
